RULE: Import the 'requests' library before using it.
RULE: Only give concise, directly relevant answers to the user’s explicit question and avoid unsolicited, overly detailed plans or generic advice.
RULE: Always set a valid tool_choice (or disable tool calls) before the model generates content that may invoke a tool.
RULE: Throttle requests to stay below the 8000 tokens per minute limit.
RULE: Do not request more tokens in a minute than the organization’s TPM limit (e.g., keep requests below 8000 tokens per minute).

RULE: Always specify a tool_choice when a tool call is expected; do not allow the model to call a tool without an explicit tool_choice.
